posts.title: Scott Watermasysk - November 19, 2026
posts.description: Migrating a MySQL db to PlanetScale is interesting. The ability to proxy data in either direction and switch back and forth is something I did not expect. For complicated and large scale moves, the ability to back out even after a cut over is powerful. I sincerely hope I never need to use it. 😄

posts.title: Scott Watermasysk - November 18, 2026
posts.description: I get the argument that most businesses don’t want to be in the software business. But you increasingly need smaller teams to pull this off. I think the world where businesses just build what they need is coming. We will still need software engineers, but they will need to be far more business-minded and customer-focused than before.
